Thank you for your time! Yes, we can target consumers by census tract numbers. 
Census_State_Country_Tract
Census State Country Tract
(SSCCCTTTTTT)
11 Census Combined Code without Block.
Census_State_Code_2010
Census State Code 2010
2
Used to idenƟfy states, territories and
possessions.
Codes range from 01‐Alabama to 78‐
Virgin Islands (not all inclusive). Note
that there is not consistency in state
code assignment across ﬁles.
County_Code
County Code
3
Used together with state code to
idenƟfy counƟes, parishes, independent
ciƟes, (or boroughs and census areas in
Alaska) within the United States.
